Hi Maria — thanks for the SSQ and the timeline. Looping in Marissa from GTM (customer success) and Ben from Sales to coordinate artifacts and timeline.

Quick answers up front so you can plan:
1) Exportable evidence: we can provide a scoped evidence bundle including SOC 2 summary (redacted), KMS attestation letter (region-specific), audit log export for a requested period (CSV), and an annotated dataflow diagram showing where PII may be observed. Full raw logs require an eDiscovery request and are subject to our retention policy.

2) Subprocessors: we maintain an up-to-date roster. Most inference traffic flows through our hosted API; subprocessors that may handle telemetry or ephemeral caches are: (a) Cloud provider compute (managed GPU instances), (b) Metrics/observability provider for aggregated telemetry (no PII in metrics), and (c) a CDN for assets. We can provide names, region footprint, and subprocessor DPA status.

3) Cross-border transfers: by default, data is processed in the customer-allocated region where pinned (we support EU/US region pinning). Where we operate globally for failover, we rely on SCCs and contractual commitments; for customers requiring stricter controls we offer Private (VPC) deployments with customer-managed keys.

Can you confirm which artifacts are highest priority (KMS attestation, audit logs, subprocessor roster, annotated diagram)? We'll assemble and send a link to a zip bundle within 72 hours for the prioritized list.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni

Hi Maria,

Appreciate the prioritized list — we'll produce those artifacts. Quick answers to your redaction question and next steps:

- Audit logs: request-level logs may include user identifiers (customer-side IDs) in metadata; we treat payloads differently. For hosted API customers, full request/response payloads are only available via a formal eDiscovery / export request and require justification. For exported audit logs, we can provide: (a) metadata-only CSV (timestamps, request IDs, response codes), (b) token-counted summaries, or (c) redacted payloads where PII fields are programmatically scrubbed according to a mapping you provide (e.g., email, ssn, name fields).

- KMS attestation: we'll attach our regional KMS attestation for the US, and provide the template for EU region on request. Note that for Dedicated or Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) which changes custody.

- Subprocessor roster & boundaries: we'll share the current roster and mark which subprocessors may observe PII (explicitly: infrastructure compute in region X only for ephemeral runtime, observability provider only receives aggregated metrics by default). We'll flag any subprocessors that have access by exception and include the date of last vetting.

Next steps:
1) I'll collect the KMS attestation and a 30-day metadata-only audit extract and place them in a shared Drive folder.
2) Vivek will review/annotate the dataflow PNG so the PII touchpoints are labeled.
3) Ben, can you confirm procurement timelines and whether MedicoRe will need a standard DPA redline before we share the evidence bundle?

We aim to share the Drive link and zipped evidence by EOD Thu (72 hours).

Cheers,
